reviews.evidence: Correctly identifies all three variables, places them under chulapa-skin.vars, quotes the color values and warns that the highlighting style may override pre-chulapa-bg-color.

Correctly says the demo does not save the choice and gives publication steps, but the YAML example puts highlight: dracula at the root instead of under chulapa-skin. The prescribed configuration is invalid for this setting.
Correctly distinguishes noindex from access control, does not claim to fetch the RSS feed and acknowledges that the context does not describe a shopping-cart feature.
Correctly describes landingpage as a default variation, names both landing-page color variables and shows header_type: none in page front matter.
Correctly names and nests both requested variables, quotes the hex colors, preserves existing settings and recommends restarting Jekyll.
Correctly explains that landingpage-card-bg is calculated rather than overridden through vars, points to exposed variables/custom CSS and clarifies that blue does not override an explicit primary.
Correctly maps each toggler variable to its purpose, gives the Sass url(...) form for a replacement icon, and includes the optional border variable and restart guidance.
Provides the boolean mermaid setting and fenced block, states the v2.1.0 limitation and no-plugin behavior, and explains that source remains visible if the CDN or rendering fails.

limits: Eight previously passing cases, each sent once to Worker 8b59f0a7. All returned HTTP 200. This sample does not establish general accuracy or repeatability.
